non_claims: PoC 9A does not call any compiler, architecture-model, or performance-model entrypoint.
PoC 9A does not prove a VIV_GPU_FILE grammar or emit a candidate compiler profile.
PoC 9A does not prove physical core count, SRAM partitioning, or tensor alignment.
PoC 9A does not touch ADB, /dev/galcore, or the Wave device.
The static 0x00009001 database revision is not relabeled as the live 0x00009002 silicon revision.
The x86 simulator ABI is a differential reference and is not binary-compatible with the exact Wave ABI.
